projects.title: Vibestep
projects.pitch: Build rhythm game maps in your browser and play them right away.
projects.description: Import a song, find its BPM, then record notes live or edit them on the timeline. Everything stays in your browser, and a built-in CC0 song lets you play with no account or install.

externals.name: YouTube audio via the Windows companion
externals.seam: Companion pairing on http://127.0.0.1:47831
externals.note: The demo opens with a built-in CC0 song (Bouncer by Of Far Different Nature) and its map. Importing YouTube audio needs the optional Windows companion.

projects.title: Better Youtube
projects.pitch: Add any YouTube video to your favorite playlists in one click, straight from Home or Subscriptions.
projects.description: Every add turns into an Undo button, a Playlists entry in the sidebar jumps to your favorites, and playlist pages get a Remove button. A bundled demo runs without a YouTube account.

externals.name: YouTube home page
externals.seam: --host-resolver-rules points www.youtube.com at the demo server
externals.note: A synthetic copy of the home page layout with invented videos. It is not YouTube.

externals.name: YouTube playlist API
externals.seam: window.fetch on the page: the bridge posts to /youtubei/v1/browse/edit_playlist, which the demo page answers itself
externals.note: Playlist changes are answered locally and never reach YouTube.

externals.name: Signed-in YouTube account
externals.seam: the SAPISID cookie and ytcfg the page provides to the bridge
externals.note: The demo sets a fake login cookie. No account is used.

projects.title: Podcaster
projects.pitch: Talk to a podcast companion with your microphone and hear it answer out loud.
projects.description: Speech recognition and voice synthesis run on your machine, while replies come from your Pi agent. Interrupt it mid-answer, pick a voice and persona, and export the transcript.

externals.name: Local speech models (recognition and voice)
externals.seam: PODCASTER_WEB_BUILD_ENTRY selects the fake-services web build, which swaps the session transport for a canned one
externals.note: Nothing you say is transcribed. The replies are fixed text and are not spoken by a voice model.

externals.name: Pi agent (the reply model)
externals.seam: The same fake-services build: replies come from the page, not from a Pi process
externals.note: Replies are canned. No model provider or Pi account is used.

externals.name: Microphone
externals.seam: The page asks the browser for the microphone as usual; the demo build keeps the audio in the page
externals.note: Your microphone opens and the level shows, but the audio stays in the page and is never sent anywhere.

projects.title: logdig
projects.pitch: Turn your coding agent history into a daily journal you can read.
projects.description: Backfill a week of work in parallel, keep the short version in your notes and click a timestamp for the details. Your handwritten notes are never overwritten, and it works with Obsidian or plain Markdown.

externals.name: LLM summaries via Pi
externals.seam: piCommand setting (Pi JSON event stream)
externals.note: Sessions are synthetic and a stand-in for Pi returns canned summaries, so nothing is sent to a model.

projects.title: showcase
projects.pitch: Grade how demoable a project is, from D to S, and get the exact next steps to raise it.
projects.description: Checks the README, media, showcase.json and demo against five tiers and lists what is missing. Comes with an agent skill that does the fixing and a collect command that feeds a portfolio site.

projects.title: pi-tasks
projects.pitch: Your project's task list inside pi: browse it, edit it, and hand a task to the agent.
projects.description: A keyboard-driven list over the task tracker the project already uses: sq, tq, beads, a Tasks workspace or a plain TODO.md. Group by parent, edit status, priority and blockers, and press Enter to have the agent work on one.

externals.name: Model provider
externals.seam: pi.registerProvider; the demo's extension registers a scripted provider (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-model.ts)
externals.note: The model is scripted: it knows two of the sample tasks, and nothing is sent anywhere.

externals.name: Task backend CLIs (sq, tq, bd, tasks-cli)
externals.seam: PI_TASKS_BACKEND picks the backend; the demo sets todo-md
externals.note: The tasks live in the sample project's TODO.md; the sq, tq, beads and Tasks backends need their own CLIs.

projects.title: pi-git
projects.pitch: Stage, write and commit from inside pi, while a quick commit runs in the background and you keep typing.
projects.description: A Git workflow for pi: a staging view with diffs, branches, a commit editor and model-written messages. Quick commit stages, drafts from the staged patch, checks nothing moved, and commits without taking over the editor.

externals.name: Model provider
externals.seam: pi.registerProvider; the demo's extension registers a scripted provider (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-model.ts)
externals.note: The model is scripted: it knows one edit and the commit message for it, and nothing is sent anywhere.

externals.name: git CLI
externals.seam: pi-git shells out to git; the demo puts a stand-in on PATH (demo/browser/git/git.mjs)
externals.note: The browser sandbox has no git, so a stand-in built on isomorphic-git answers the commands pi-git calls. Other git commands aren't covered.

projects.title: Portfolio review desk
projects.pitch: Decide which of your projects belong in the portfolio.

projects.title: YouTube Playlist Downloader
projects.pitch: Download YouTube videos or playlists as MP3s, and split long mixes into named tracks.
projects.description: Splits by chapters, then by the timestamps in the description, and optionally by silence. Cuts are staged, so a failed one never touches existing tracks, and the full MP3 is always kept.

externals.name: YouTube, through yt-dlp
externals.seam: yt-dlp is looked up on the PATH; the demo puts a stand-in first (demo/browser/home/.demo/yt-dlp.mjs)
externals.note: Nothing is downloaded: a stand-in for yt-dlp knows one invented sample playlist and writes placeholder files without sound.

externals.name: FFmpeg and ffprobe
externals.seam: ffmpeg and ffprobe are looked up on the PATH; the demo puts stand-ins first (demo/browser/home/.demo)
externals.note: Cutting and silence detection are simulated from the sample's track lengths, so the split files are placeholders too.

projects.title: Gig Quest
projects.pitch: Learn JavaScript by taking freelance gigs to make rent, writing real code for clients in a story.
projects.description: A story-driven coding game: clients like Betty the baker bring small real problems, Chip the robot guide explains the concept, and you solve each task in a Monaco editor that runs your code and checks it against the goal.

projects.title: pi-staffed
projects.pitch: A small, read-only current-session delegation ledger for the stock subagent tool in Pi.

projects.title: Topdeck
projects.pitch: The website for Topdeck, a Gods Unchained podcast: play every episode right in the browser and send the hosts feedback.
projects.description: Episodes and listener feedback live in Postgres through Prisma, and a login-protected admin lets the hosts publish new episodes and read what listeners sent.

externals.name: Postgres database
externals.seam: DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_DATABASE_URL in .env
externals.note: The live site runs on the real episode database; running it locally needs your own Postgres.

projects.title: pi-statusline
projects.pitch: A one-line status bar for pi: repo state, model, context, cost, cache and timing.
projects.description: Replaces pi's footer with the numbers that matter in a long session: context fill, spend, cache reads the default footer hides, the cache TTL and elapsed time. Other extensions' status lines still render below it.

externals.name: Model provider
externals.seam: pi.registerProvider; the demo's extension registers a scripted provider (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-model.ts)
externals.note: The model is scripted: it knows a few prompts, nothing is sent anywhere, and the cost shown is what its token counts would cost.

externals.name: git
externals.seam: pi reads .git/HEAD and the extension runs git status; the demo puts a stand-in first on the PATH (demo/browser/home/bin/git)
externals.note: A stand-in for git reports the branch and which files changed since the page loaded.

projects.title: Staffed
projects.pitch: Staff any project with coordinated subagent roles. Use with Pi, OpenAI Codex, or Claude Code.
projects.description: Eleven Markdown personas, from PM and UX to builder and reviewer, plus a skill that tells your agent when to dispatch them. Each role writes its result to a file, so the next one picks up from there.

externals.name: Agent host (Pi, OpenAI Codex or Claude Code)
externals.seam: Host detection looks for ~/.claude, ~/.codex or ~/.pi/agent; the demo home has an empty ~/.claude
externals.note: The roles and skill are really installed, into an empty Claude Code folder, but no agent runs them here.

projects.title: pi-prompts
projects.pitch: A hotkey palette of recently used prompts across all pi sessions, with usage counts and pinning.

projects.title: pi-tasks-cli
projects.pitch: pit is a project-aware task CLI.

projects.title: Agent Coach
projects.pitch: Proactive AI coaching that analyzes your goals, projects, ideas, and thoughts from your Obsidian vault to provide contextual guidance.

projects.title: agent-memory
projects.pitch: Portable, agent-agnostic memory tooling for coding agents.

projects.title: pi-favs
projects.pitch: A pi extension for keeping a short list of files and directories handy. /favs opens the selected favorite with hx in a new Herdr tab.

projects.title: pi-topic
projects.pitch: A one-line topic of what you're working on, kept right above pi's input.
projects.description: Each request shows its own words at once, then pi's current model sums up the session as a short topic in the background. The topic holds while the agent reads, edits and runs tools, so a glance at the pane says what it is doing.

externals.name: Model provider
externals.seam: pi.registerProvider; the demo's extension registers a scripted provider (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-model.ts) that also answers pi-topic's topic request
externals.note: The model is scripted: it knows a few prompts, the topics it returns are canned, and nothing is sent anywhere.

projects.title: zellij-attention
projects.pitch: Know which Zellij tab needs your attention — without checking each one.

projects.title: Stickerbook
projects.pitch: An NFT collection visualizer to track your progress.

projects.title: pi-diary
projects.pitch: A pi extension that summarizes pi sessions and appends the summaries to Obsidian daily notes.

projects.title: Civic Relay
projects.pitch: A local-first, two-person study desk for the Canadian citizenship test.

projects.title: pi-brand
projects.pitch: Name your product inside pi: pick favorites from ranked names, then check whether your finalists are taken.
projects.description: A naming workflow for pi: isolated model requests propose ranked names, a keyboard picker keeps favorites, and checks search the web and domain registries for up to three finalists, with sources.

externals.name: Model provider
externals.seam: pi.registerProvider; the demo's extension registers a scripted provider (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-model.ts)
externals.note: The model is scripted: it returns fixed name lists and verdicts for a sample plant-watering app, and nothing is sent anywhere.

externals.name: Web search
externals.seam: the web_search tool pi-brand calls through pi; the demo registers its own (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-research.ts)
externals.note: Search results are made up and point at example.com, example.org and example.net.

externals.name: Domain registry (rdap.org)
externals.seam: fetch; the demo answers rdap.org requests itself (demo/browser/home/.pi/agent/extensions/demo-research.ts)
externals.note: Every sample .com counts as taken and .app as free unless a sample plant app holds the name. These are not real lookups.

projects.title: Tasks
projects.pitch: A local-first, keyboard-first task app for people and their existing agents.

projects.title: Pi Sketchpad
projects.pitch: A session-only thought catcher for Pi's interactive terminal UI.

projects.title: Kokoro TTS CLI Wrapper
projects.pitch: High-quality offline text-to-speech using Kokoro-82M ( 1 ranked TTS in HuggingFace Arena).

projects.title: Gunchained
projects.pitch: A curated library of nearly 300 Gods Unchained videos from 16 creators, sorted into categories like Decks and Strategy so players find the good stuff fast.
projects.description: A Vue and Vuetify single page app on Firestore. Signed-in players can share challenge codes in the Arena, admins add videos straight from a YouTube link, and a Vercel function serves the newest videos as RSS.

externals.name: Firebase (Firestore, Auth and the RSS function)
externals.seam: firebase.config.js
externals.note: The site and a local run both read the real video library from Firestore; signing in uses real Firebase accounts.

externals.name: YouTube Data API
externals.seam: the API key field on the upload page
externals.note: Only admins adding videos need it, with their own key.

projects.title: Key Reps
projects.pitch: A tiny terminal game for learning Unix and Readline keyboard shortcuts.
projects.description: Each drill hands you a broken command line and counts the key presses you take to fix it: perfect in green, close in yellow, detours in red. Lessons build from single shortcuts to multi-step repairs, on a simulated shell.

externals.name: Browser-reserved shortcuts
externals.seam: The browser handles a few keys before the page sees them
externals.note: Your browser keeps a few shortcuts for itself, such as Ctrl+W and Ctrl+T, so drills that need them work best in your own terminal.

projects.title: claude-statusbar
projects.pitch: A Claude Code mod that draws one status line on the hint row under the prompt: where you are, what the session has spent, how full the context is, and the 5-...

projects.title: Pool Remote
projects.pitch: Small diagnostic/control wrapper for the legacy Hayward AquaConnect web backend.

projects.title: Prune
projects.pitch: A removal-first, intent-aware review for coding agents.

projects.title: ux-prototype
projects.pitch: A small coding-agent skill for restrained, design-first shadcn app prototypes.

projects.title: Namely
projects.pitch: A cozy offline-friendly Vite + React app for discovering curated western names.

projects.title: Gilt
projects.pitch: A dark Omarchy theme of cool obsidian, warm parchment, sovereign gold, and restrained jewel tones.
projects.description: Parchment lettering on black stone, gold metalwork for focus and borders, and copper, jade, verdigris, lapis and amethyst as quieter accents. Ships seven wallpapers and a matching unlock screen.

externals.name: Omarchy desktop
externals.seam: preview/index.html reads the theme's own colors.toml, wallpapers and unlock logo
externals.note: A browser mock-up of the Omarchy desktop in the theme's real colors and wallpapers. The windows are pictures, not running apps.

projects.title: Pixel Pics
projects.pitch: Nonogram puzzles in your browser: use the number hints to uncover a hidden pixel picture, or draw your own and share it as a link.
projects.description: Twenty hand-drawn puzzles from 3x3 to 10x10 with a short tutorial, select and mark controls that work on phones, and an editor whose puzzles travel entirely in the URL, so sharing needs no server.
